plan.goal: Implement the deterministic typed Session connection state machine over stepped transports without gameplay transfer.
acceptance: Implement the exact four-packet two-Hello handshake, phase-specific schema binding, bounded negotiation and endpoint-specific Result timing.
Own and validate authority/replica scope and replicator at the frozen lifecycle seams without Capture, Apply, command build or dispatch.
Enforce header limits before decoded allocation and implement exact semantic, sequence, retry and transport-exception behavior.
Implement Requested close, rejection delivery barrier, terminal mapping and explicit Session disposal ownership.
Expose only the frozen short public API and internal test probes, preserve all protocol/replication code, and pass the full package suite.

riskToTest.risk: Handshake or rejection advances before reliable ownership is committed
riskToTest.test: Capacity-one pair pump plus connected-false and throwing transport retry matrix with exact bytes and sequences

riskToTest.risk: Peer-controlled header causes allocation above negotiated limits
riskToTest.test: Pre-decode attacker-length tests proving no decoded rent before local bound rejection

riskToTest.risk: Topology/lifecycle drift acknowledges an unusable replica mapping
riskToTest.test: Authority and replica invalidation at every retry, Ack and established Step seam with no ECS mutation

commands: Focused warnings-as-errors Session compile and tests
